ModMetaData.name: NPC Outposts: Rim War (Community)
ModMetaData.author: GuanYu Lu
ModMetaData.description:
Bridges NPC Outposts into the Rim War grand strategy layer.

- Satellite outposts feed Rim War points to their parent settlement every growth cycle (per-type tunable).
- Outposts become legitimate warband targets: hostile war parties will march on them and resolve abstract battles.
- A captured outpost defects to the conqueror (or is razed, configurable) instead of being rebuilt as a vanilla settlement; when a settlement itself changes hands, its satellites follow.
- War momentum: factions winning settlement battles grow outposts faster; losing factions slow down and may see outposts wither.

Requires Harmony, Rim War and NPC Outposts (Community). Safe to add to existing saves.
